title: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
tagline: Cheese, crackers and one very suspicious penguin.
about: Wallace's helpful robot gnome goes rogue, and Gromit suspects an old feathered enemy is behind it.
cue: Serve the cheese when Wallace sits down for a snack at West Wallaby Street.
